gloss: to go back to square one; to start from scratch; to scrap

definitions.gloss: to go back to square one; to start from scratch; to cancel and redo
definitions.explanation: To abandon plans, agreements, or progress and return to the very beginning, as if nothing had been decided yet.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}を{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}す。
examples.english: Scrap the plan and start over.

examples.japanese: {交渉|こうしょう}は{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}された。
examples.english: The negotiations were sent back to square one.

examples.japanese: {住民|じゅうみん}の{反対|はんたい}を{受|う}けて、{市|し}は{開発|かいはつ}{計画|けいかく}を{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}すことを{決|き}めた。
examples.english: Facing opposition from residents, the city decided to scrap the development plan.

notes:
Literally "to return to blank paper." {白紙|はくし} (blank paper) symbolizes a state where nothing has been written or decided — a clean slate.

USAGE:
Common in news and formal contexts when plans, policies, or agreements are completely canceled. Stronger than simply revising or modifying — it implies everything is discarded and must be reconsidered from zero. Often used in passive form: {白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}された.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計画|けいかく}を{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}す — to scrap a plan
- {合意|ごうい}を{白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}す — to void an agreement
- {白紙|はくし}に{戻|もど}して{考|かんが}え{直|なお}す — to go back to the drawing board
- {白紙|はくし}{撤回|てっかい} — complete withdrawal/cancellation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}る — to go back to the starting point
- {撤回|てっかい}する — to retract, to withdraw; to take back a statement or proposal
- やり{直|なお}す — to redo; more casual, implies trying again
